description: Convert between JPEG, PNG and WebP, one file or many, with transparency flattened onto a colour you choose. HEIC and AVIF are browser-only and not accepted here. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

background.description: A CSS colour painted behind transparent areas when converting to JPEG, which has no transparency. Defaults to white. Ignored for PNG and WebP targets.

data.description: The image file as base64, in the format given by type.

name.description: The source filename. The result keeps its stem with the target format's extension.

quality.description: Encoder quality from 0.1 to 1 when the target is JPEG or WebP; lower is smaller and softer. PNG is lossless and ignores it.

target.description: The format to convert to: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp. It must differ from type; converting to the same format is refused. AVIF is not available over the API.

type.description: The MIME type of the source image: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp. HEIC, AVIF, TIFF and BMP are not accepted over the API.

name: image_converter
title: Image Converter
